setup.title: Wine Map
setup.subtitle: No poses. Just wine.
setup.description: Drag each denomination onto its region. Learn the map of Italian wine, one card at a time.

game.dragInstruction: Drag to the correct region on the map

profile.emptySubtitle: Complete your first session to see your statistics.
profile.quizEmptySubtitle: Sit your first exam or study session to see how you're doing.
profile.quizNoExams: No exams submitted yet — your practice still counts below.

autoPlace.title: Maximum attempts reached
autoPlace.subtitle: The correct answer has been revealed.

quiz.emptySubtitle: There aren't enough questions loaded to make a paper. Come back once the bank has been filled.
quiz.unavailableSubtitle: Couldn't reach the cellar to draw you a paper. Nothing is lost — try again in a moment.

practice.name: Practice
practice.blurb: One level, the length you have time for, and the tannin tells you straight after every answer. This is where you actually study.

review.name: Error Review
review.blurb: Only the questions you keep getting wrong, and they stop coming back once you've had them right in three separate sessions.
review.pending: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting. You've mastered everything you've been asked.} one {# question still waiting to be mastered} other {# questions still waiting to be mastered}}

practice.title: Study, not sentencing.
practice.subtitle: Pick the level you have lessons on and how long you've got. Nothing here is passed or failed.
practice.openNote: {count} of them are written answers, and the tannin reads every word.

rules.level: Every question comes from the level you picked, and nowhere else.
rules.feedback: You're told straight away whether you got it, while you still remember why you said it.
rules.adaptive: Questions you've never seen come first, then the ones you got wrong before.
rules.noVerdict: No pass, no fail. That number is the exam's job, not this one's.

practice.thinSubtitle: There aren't enough questions loaded at this level to fill a session that long. Try a shorter one, or another level.
practice.stalledBody: That one didn't get marked, and nothing was counted against you. Send it again and he'll have another go.
practice.notFoundSubtitle: This session isn't yours or no longer exists. Start a fresh one.

endWarn.title: Stop here?
endWarn.body: {count, plural, =0 {You haven't answered anything yet, so there's nothing to record.} one {# answer given. You'll be scored on that one and nothing else.} other {# answers given. You'll be scored on those and nothing else.}}

result.title: Session done.
result.subtitle: No verdict, no certificate. Just what you know and what you don't, which is the useful half.
result.nothingSubtitle: You stopped before answering anything, so there's nothing to count. Come back when you have five minutes.

review.title: Your mistakes, and nobody else's.
review.subtitle: Only questions you've already been asked and haven't learned yet. One leaves for good after you get it right in {count} separate sessions.
review.pool: {count, plural, one {# question still waiting to be mastered} other {# questions still waiting to be mastered}}
review.pending: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing left to master.} one {# still to master} other {# still to master}}
review.lengthNote: If there are fewer left than that, you get what's left. No padding.

rules.pool: Every question here is one you've already been asked and haven't learned yet.
rules.mastered: Get one right in {count} separate sessions and it's gone for good.
rules.everyMode: Right answers count wherever you gave them — practice, exam, here.
rules.feedback: You're told straight away, while you still remember why you said it.

review.emptySubtitle: Either you haven't been asked anything yet, or you've mastered every question you have been. Both are fixed the same way: go and get asked some more.
review.stalledBody: That one didn't get marked, and nothing was counted against you. Send it again and he'll have another go.
review.notFoundSubtitle: This session isn't yours or no longer exists. Start a fresh one.

endWarn.title: Stop here?
endWarn.body: {count, plural, =0 {You haven't answered anything yet, so nothing counts towards mastering anything.} one {# answer given. Only that one counts towards mastering a question.} other {# answers given. Only those count towards mastering a question.}}

result.title: Session done.
result.subtitle: No verdict, no certificate. Just a shorter list than you started with.
result.nothingSubtitle: You stopped before answering anything, so nothing moved. Your mistakes are exactly where you left them.
result.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {That's the lot. Nothing left to master — for now.} one {# question still waiting to be mastered.} other {# questions still waiting to be mastered.}}

start.title: Would you pass right now?
start.subtitle: One sitting, {count} questions, the whole course. The tannin marks it and tells you straight.

rules.length: {count} questions, one per screen. Go back and change your mind as often as you like.
rules.levels: All three levels in one paper, exactly like the real thing.
rules.passMark: Pass at {pct}%. Blanks count as wrong, so guess rather than skip.
rules.timer: The clock is shown but never stops you. This is study, not an ambush.

start.composition: {open} written answers, {multipleChoice} multiple choice, {trueFalse} true or false. The written ones you type yourself, and the tannin reads every word.

resume.practiceTitle: You left a practice session open
resume.reviewTitle: You left a review session open
resume.progress: {answered} of {total} answered. Nothing was lost — it waits as long as you need.
resume.abandon: Bin it and start a new one

warn.body: {count, plural, =0 {It's untouched, so there's nothing to mourn. Gone for good, though.} one {# answer goes in the bin with it, for good.} other {# answers go in the bin with it, for good.}}

exam.notFoundSubtitle: This paper isn't yours or no longer exists. Start a fresh one.
exam.openPlaceholder: Write your answer. Your own words are fine — the point is what you know, not how you phrase it.

review.title: Before you hand it in
review.allAnswered: Every question answered. Nothing left on the table.
review.blanks: {count, plural, one {# question left blank} other {# questions left blank}} — every one of them counts as wrong.
review.jumpHint: Tap a number to go back to it.

warn.title: Handing in with blanks?
warn.body: {count, plural, one {# question is} other {# questions are}} still empty. They will be marked wrong. Sure?

result.gradingBody: The multiple choice is done — it's below. The written ones take a moment longer, because somebody actually has to read them.
result.gradingStalledBody: Some of your written answers didn't get marked. Nothing was counted wrong for it and your paper is untouched — ask again and it picks up where it stopped.
result.passedSubtitle: You'd have walked out of that room with the certificate. Do it again next week and it stops being luck.
result.failedSubtitle: Not today. The good news is you now know exactly which questions cost you the pass.
